meta.title: Nextline — Input Predictions
meta.description: Suggests your next message after a completed reply and continues a draft in progress, with an independently selected model. Never sends automatically.

title: Input predictions
intro: After a reply finishes, suggest one useful next message. Accept it into an editable draft; sending is always up to you.
enabledHint: Suggestions never replace your text or send a message.
automaticHint: When off, press Tab in the focused composer or click to predict: an empty composer suggests a whole message, existing text continues your draft. Press Tab again to accept; any edit re-predicts.
providerHint: Reuse a provider already configured in Models.
modelHint: Independent of the model used in your conversation.
chooseModel: Select or enter a model ID
privacy: Only recent text from the current conversation is sent to the selected prediction provider; pressing Tab on a non-empty draft also sends that draft to continue it. No reasoning, file contents, or tool results are included. Normal provider charges may apply. Suggestions may be wrong; review before sending.
configFailed: Prediction settings are unavailable. Reconnecting automatically.
noSuggestion: No useful next-message suggestion right now.
timedOut: Prediction timed out. Retry or adjust the timeout in settings.
draftChanged: Your draft changed. Press Tab to predict again.
